papers.title_in_file: Variational Quantum Monte Carlo investigations of the superconducting pairing in La3Ni2O7
papers.what_it_is: A condensed-matter paper that uses classical variational Monte Carlo on a bilayer two-orbital Hubbard model and t-J model to compare s-pm-wave and d-wave pairing in pressurized La3Ni2O7.
papers.why_not: The paper studies superconducting pairing symmetry in a nickelate with classical variational Monte Carlo. It has no quantum computing, quantum machine learning, machine learning, finance or evaluation-method content, so it fits none of the five contexts. The brief stores no assertions for it.
